desc: Cotton can block data from getting into a gem's mind or device, or push more in. She can fog up what a gem knows instead of erasing it, or sharpen their understanding of a subject and raise how much a device can take in.
Weakness: She has to reach the mind or device directly. A shielded device, or a gem who isn't thinking about anything (like one who's Asleep), gives her nothing to work with.
abilities.label: Sub-Domain: Data · Advanced
abilities.name: Data Manipulation

outside.name: Infodump
outside.text: Outside of battle, she can load any amount of knowledge onto a device.

passives.name: Hyperfixation
passives.text: Cotton can spend her whole turn studying one enemy, without attacking or casting. If she does, she learns their stats and spells as if she had CHECKed them, and that enemy has disadvantage on resisting her next spell. If she's hit before her next turn, the study is lost.

spells.name: Brain Malfunction
spells.text: Cotton scrambles one target's thoughts. They resist with INT. If they fail, they're Hushed for 2 turns and can't use spells.

spells.name: Glitch Out
spells.text: Cotton lets off an electromagnetic blast. Every enemy who is Near takes 2d6 damage and resists with SPD, taking half if they pass. Gem Machines can't resist and always take full damage.

spells.name: Helping Brain
spells.text: Cotton sharpens one ally's mind. They get +4 INT for 3 turns.

spells.name: Infodump
spells.text: Cotton uploads everything she knows about one enemy to her whole party. Every ally learns that enemy's stats and spells as if they had CHECKed them, and the party's next attack against that enemy has advantage.

desc: She can picture a structure and project a blueprint of it in hard light, then make it real for a short time!
abilities.label: Bi-Colored Kandy Sole Essence
abilities.name: Holoprint

spells.name: Holoprint Barrier
spells.text: She builds a hard light wall beside herself or an ally! Anyone behind it counts as Behind. The wall has 5 + MAG HP and takes hits meant for whoever it covers until it breaks or 3 turns pass.

art.alt: Cotton's reference sheet: a tall pale gem with short white hair and pink eyes, wearing a black bodysuit under a pink jacket with a cyan stripe, a pink belt and holster, and a flower emblem on her thigh, with sketches of the large flower marking across her back and her flower shaped gemstone

dislikes: Being the center of attention or having to make public appearances
Crowded environments and overwhelming social gatherings
Public scrutiny, gossip, and unnecessary criticism
Gems who abuse their authority or mistreat others
Being pressured into conversations or decisions
Sudden disruptions to her carefully organized work
Being compared to other Cubic Zirconias
fear: Being publicly humiliated or scrutinized. Disappointing gems who place their trust in her. Making a serious mistake that negatively affects others. Being forced into a public-facing position. Having her private life or personal interests exposed. Never developing the confidence she admires in other Regents.
heroSub: Pale Pink Cubic Zirconia of Court Kandy, a complete recluse who specializes in data type spells, and a secret fan of Grand Regents Reina and Antton.
likes: Working with data, organizing information, and designing layouts
Developing and experimenting with data-based spells
Quiet environments and spending time alone
Helping gems who genuinely seek their guidance
Receiving thoughtful gifts and small tokens of appreciation
Watching or listening to Grand Regents Reina and Antton
Admiring the confidence and leadership of other Regents

Soft fabrics, delicate decorations, and aesthetically pleasing arrangements
name: Grand Regent Cotton
personality: Grand Regent Cotton is a complete recluse compared to other Cubic Zirconias. Instead of being the public face for her gem like most others, they prefer to hide away rather than face public scrutiny. Despite being a no-show, Grand Regent Cotton is actually extremely sweet and will genuinely treat gems that seek out their presence or counsel with kindness and respect; they may just be a bit shy at first. She is also a huge secret fan of Grand Regents Reina and Antton! She admires that they have the confidence that she doesn't have.
relationships: Her sibling. Cotton holds a special familial attachment to them, even if their personalities and approaches to social life differ.
Someone Cotton deeply admires for her confidence, presence, and ability to command a room.
Another personal idol of Cotton's. She admires their confidence and the way they carry themselves as a Grand Regent.
Cotton loves her sibling, though they are complete polar opposites. She will often seek Cece out when having a difficult time!
title: Grand Regent Cotton
